# What VS14 Is
Vacation Station 14 is a casual SS14 hangout server. Light roleplay, creativity over violence, and a chosen-family vibe where players share the space and take care of it together.
It's built for players who don't have time to grind heavier-RP servers and just want a regular community to drop into. Bring your character, make it work — the bar is participation, not pristine performance.
## A unique fork
Most SS14 servers run one upstream's content. VS14 is curated: the base is pure SS14, with hand-picked subsystems woven in from sibling stations for content variety. The round won't match any other server you've played.
The through-line is creativity and collaboration over competition and combat — what players build, scheme, and improvise together. Community events bridge our Discord and the game, so the hangout extends past any single round.
## Casual, not chaotic
The community is closer to a co-op than a crew. We share the space, take care of it together, and trust players to bring the bit. Roleplay can go in any direction; the only hard line is no NSFW content.
A few baselines that shape how rounds feel here:
- Antagonists are part of the round, not the point of it. Damage proportional to the objective; don't ruin everyone's evening to win. - Command and security set the tone. If you take one of those roles, take it seriously enough that the rest of the crew can rely on you. - Self-antagging is the fastest way to get banned. If you're not flagged as an antagonist, you're crew.
The full rules — community, in-round, command, antag, silicon — live under [textlink="Server Rules" link="DefaultRuleset"/].
## Where the community lives
- [bold]In-game[/bold], on this server. Hub-listed as "Vacation Station 14." - [bold]In Discord[/bold], where most between-rounds hangout happens. - [bold]On GitHub[/bold] at [color=cyan]github.com/azigler/vacation-station-14[/color] — the code, the task tracker, and this guidebook all live there.
You don't need GitHub or Discord to play. They're there if you want them.
